title: Lior and the Orchard
author: Marguerite Fairweather
blurb: Coral Ashgrove, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
